name: temporal-8fps
notes: D3 ResNet18 option, L2 discrepancy; ranking only. All 26 previously published source files are retained. The bounded ai_score coordinate is 1/(1+raw temporal_std), with no decision threshold or calibration. Author BGR preprocessing is preserved. This is an adaptation to deterministic center-window sampling and directly decoded source frames: upstream uses random-window 8 fps JPEG frames, and its main model is XCLIP, not this lightweight option. The 8 fps profile checks native-like timing without introducing JPEG encoding. See configs/temporal-ranking-policy.md. Counts do not measure general accuracy or establish a replacement for the demo.
